text_block_list.text:
Living up to the fans' expectations, 
Mihono Bourbon claimed victory at the 
Nippon Derby.

Rice Shower stumbled up to her, completely 
exhausted. Whispering, "I couldn't catch 
up...", she collapsed unconscious.

There are only two outcomes in a race: 
victory or defeat. Even so, she couldn't 
understand why Rice Shower was so fixated 
on "catching up"...

Told by her Trainer that "the day will 
come when you understand," she set her 
sights on the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
